kitchen_knife.name: Kitchen Knife
kitchen_knife.flavorText: A stainless steel knife. Keep out of reach of children and scheming Upper Levels Housewives.

box_cutter.name: Box Cutter
box_cutter.flavorText: A sturdy utility knife with a retractable blade commonly used in construction, crafting and warehouse work.

combat_knife.name: Combat Knife
combat_knife.flavorText: A fighting knife designed for military use and primarily intended for hand-to-hand or close combat fighting, but also useful for utility.

combat_machete.name: Combat Machete
combat_machete.flavorText: A heavy-duty machete built for combat and survival.

pipe_weapon.name: Lead Pipe
pipe_weapon.shortDescription: A heavy lead pipe. After the Station overhauled the water line, tonnes of leftover lead piping found its way into the hands of scavs and thieves.

stun_baton.name: Stun Baton
stun_baton.shortDescription: Standard-issue stun baton with STUN and HARM modes. An everyday carry for Security Officers maintaining order in the station.

crowbar.name: Crowbar
crowbar.flavorText: The trusty tool of every experienced scavenger and theoretical physicist on the Station. Useful as a weapon in a pinch.

hatchet.name: Hatchet
hatchet.shortDescription: Small but sturdy. Can be used on a Hydroponic Farm to clear whatever is currently growing.

glass_shard_shiv.name: Glass Shiv
glass_shard_shiv.flavorText: A sharp-edged piece of broken glass wrapped in cloth that can be used as a weapon.

skinning_knife.name: Skinning Knife
skinning_knife.flavorText: The perfect knife for a veteran rancher.
